title.vi: Các mẫu phân tích kinh doanh: Pareto, tỷ trọng, YoY
title.en: Business analysis patterns: Pareto, share of total, YoY

summary.vi: tỷ trọng trên tổng bằng SUM() OVER (), quy tắc 80/20, tăng trưởng, top-N
summary.en: share of total with SUM() OVER (), the 80/20 rule, growth, top-N

files.name: query.sql
files.code:
WITH rev AS (
  SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue
  FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
  GROUP BY p.category
)
SELECT category, revenue,
       ROUND(100.0 * revenue / SUM(revenue) OVER (), 1)                       AS share_pct,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY revenue DESC) / SUM(revenue) OVER (), 1) AS cumulative_pct
FROM rev
ORDER BY revenue DESC;

prompt.vi: Tính doanh thu từng sản phẩm (name, revenue = SUM(quantity × price)) cùng share_pct = tỷ trọng % trên tổng (làm tròn 1 chữ số). Lấy 3 sản phẩm doanh thu cao nhất, sắp xếp theo revenue giảm dần rồi name.
prompt.en: Compute each product's revenue (name, revenue = SUM(quantity × price)) with share_pct = its % of the total (rounded to 1 digit). Take the 3 top products, sorted by revenue descending then name.

solution.name: query.sql
solution.code:
WITH rev AS (
  SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue
  FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
  GROUP BY p.name
)
SELECT name, revenue, ROUND(100.0 * revenue / SUM(revenue) OVER (), 1) AS share_pct
FROM rev
ORDER BY revenue DESC, name
LIMIT 3;

prompt.vi: Phân tích Pareto: đếm xem cần BAO NHIÊU sản phẩm (theo doanh thu giảm dần) để đạt ít nhất 80% tổng doanh thu. Trả về một số, cột n_products.
prompt.en: Pareto analysis: count HOW MANY products (by descending revenue) are needed to reach at least 80% of total revenue. Return one number, column n_products.

hint.vi: Tính tỷ trọng luỹ kế; đếm số sản phẩm có tỷ trọng luỹ kế TRƯỚC nó < 80%, cộng 1 (hoặc MIN rank có cumulative >= 80).
hint.en: Compute the cumulative share; count products whose cumulative share BEFORE them is < 80%.

starter.name: query.sql
starter.code: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_products FROM products;

solution.name: query.sql
solution.code:
WITH rev AS (
  SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue
  FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
  GROUP BY p.name
),
c AS (
  SELECT name, revenue,
         SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY revenue DESC, name) AS cum,
         SUM(revenue) OVER () AS total
  FROM rev
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_products
FROM c
WHERE (cum - revenue) * 1.0 / total < 0.8;
